title: Modern Marketing

questions.question: Define modern marketing?
questions.solution_html:
• Modern marketing focuses on creating value for customers by understanding their needs and
  • building long -term relationships. It uses technology, data, and customer insights to deliver
  • personalised experiences. It moves beyond selling products to satisfying customer expectations.
questions.source_exam: First Semester MGU-UGP/MGU-BBA/MGU-BCA Honours Examinations November 2025
questions.final_answer: personalised experiences. It moves beyond selling products to satisfying customer expectations.
